Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 7. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Payment online through RTGS / internet banking also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). On-line payment shall be in Beneficiary name BHARAT DYNAMIC LIMITED Account No. 104531043010001 IFSC Code UBIN0810452 Bank Name UNION BANK OF INDIA Branch address BDL CAMPUS BRANCH, KANCHANABAGH, HYDERABAD, TELANGANA-500058 . Successful Bidder to indicate Contract number and name of Seller entity in the transaction details field at the time of on-line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer in place of PBG within 15 days of award of contract. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1.Items should be complied as per Annexure-I 2.Items to be supplied along with applicable test reports / CoC and NABL calibration reports where ever ap plicable as per Annexure-I 3.Operating manual to be provided/any applicable manual as per Annexure-I 4.Inspection By: The Items will be inspected by BDL (QC) at BDL (VU) as per Annexure-II

5.Delivery Period: within 8 months from the receipt of PO 6.The items to be delivered to BDL (VU) at free of cost. 7.Warranty Clause: The vendor should provide warranty for 36 months after acceptance of items at BDL (V U).In case the unit/spare parts fail to work with in the warranty period the frim should repair/ replace the it em at free of cost. 8.Packing Condition: The items to be supplied in suitable a wooden box with proper packing so as to avoid the damage during transportation 09.Installation & Commissioning : Unloading installation & commissioning of equipment/system is responsi ble of vendor at BDL premises 10.Applicable spare items to be supplied. 11. PAYMENT TERMS AND CONDITIONS: * As the contract is for Supply, Installation, Testing and commissio ning of goods and handover in operational mode etc, the complete cost break up indicating basic price, GS T, installation and commissioning charge to be indicated separately in the bid. i. First milestone payments: Goods receipt 75% payment of the basic price of goods along with 100% taxes on the goods price within 30 days after receipt and acceptance of PO item and Generation of deliver y Generation of Consignee Receipt and Acceptance Certificate (CRAC) for initial payment. ii. Second milestone payment: Installation & Commissioning: 20% payment of the basic price of goods sho uld be paid after successful Installation and Commissioning of the equipment upon certification of BDLUser . iii. Third milestone payment: Balance 5% payment of the basic price of goods to be paid after successful t esting of the equipment and by submission of performance bank guarantee for 5% of total basic order valu e (performance bank guarantee valid till warranty period + claim per iod of 3 months). 12. “BDL reserves its right to release GST only after supplier's invoice/debit note is reflected in GST R-2B/2 A 9 / 12 within the specified time limit mentioned in GST Law”. 13. Successful bidder has to submit the Security deposit for 5% of order value after placement of order. 14. LD Clause: Time is the essence of the P.O and delivery should be strictly insisted upon according to the delivery schedule given in the SOs/POs. In the event the supplier fails to de liver the goods / service, with i n the stipulated delivery period, BDL reserves the right to recover from the supplier, LD and not by way of penalty an amount as detailed in terms and conditions. A sum of 0.5% of the price only of the stores (Inclu ding duties, taxes) which the supplier has failed to deliver as aforesaid for each week of delay or part there of, subject to a maximum of 10%.In case of extension of delivery period, increase in taxes shall not be bor ne by BDL, if delay is attributable to vendor. 15. AS 9100D Clause: •Supplier shall not supply non-conforming product against specification. •Supplier shall notify BDL of non-conforming processes, products or services and obtain approval for theird isposition (i.e. rework, rejection etc.,). •Supplier shall notify BDL of changes to manufacturing processes, products or services including changes of their external providers or location of manufacture and obtain BDL approval. •Supplier shall retain the product related records (processes, quality records etc.,) up to 3years. •BDL, its customer and regulatory authorities having right of access to the applicable areas of all your facili ties, at any level of supply chain, involved in our order and all applicable records. •Supplier shall ensure that the persons carrying out the manufacturing of items under this purchase order be aware of product conformity requirements, product safety and importance of ethical behavior etc. •Wherever drawing revisions are applicable, old drawings are to be returned to BDL or to be destroyed wit h an intimation to BDL. •Wherever applicable, ESD controls to be followed for PCB and other electronics items. •In case of any corrective action plan against non-conforming product reported/identified at any stage the

same shall be brought to the notice of BDL for approval before its implementation. •"Supplier shall not use any suspected/detected counterfeit parts" during any stage of manufacturing. •Counterfeit parts shall not be supplied to BDL. If any counterfeit parts are received, severe action shall b e initiated against the supplier. •Vendor shall comply ISO 14001:2015 EMS for the PO. 16. BDL will not acknowledge receipt of goods or service as a valid supply/ service, until all mandatory doc uments listed in purchase Order (e.g., inspection report, free issue material consumption report, warranty certificate, ePBG, GST invoice) are provided. A checklist of submitted documents is required with each sup ply. within the specified time limit mentioned in GST Law". 17. The bidder should submit the compliance statement for acceptance of attached specifications and all t erms & conditions as per the said bid. 18. The vendor participating in the tender should declare if demerged in the recent times, to declare the m erge, nature of demerger for the assessment of the credentials for acceptance of your quotations, falling o n which knowing of the demerger in the later stage by bdl, bdl will entitle the vendor for debarment. .
